answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 38354 Country: India Title: I kept the name of my son Nafey Question: I kept the name of my son Nafe. I found this name in the 99 names of Allah. So May I Know the meaning of this name or is this available in Islam or not? Is this name right or wrong? Please tell me. Answer ID: 38354 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 798/670/B=1433) Nafey (نافع) is one of the beautiful names of Allah. It means beneficial. It is right to keep Nafey as name, but if you prefix Abdul i.e. keep it as Abdun Nafey (عبدالنافع) then it shall be a better name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
